Meet Dootchi — Conversations That Feel Personal
Looking for someone to talk to, share your thoughts with, or explore a story together? Dootchi offers an AI-powered conversational experience where you can express yourself, discover different roleplay scenarios, and enjoy conversations at your own pace.

What You Can Explore
Personalized Roleplay Explore different conversational roles, from a friendly companion to a thoughtful mentor. Choose the interactions that suit your interests and create your own conversational experience.
Natural, Engaging Conversations Enjoy interactive conversations and imaginative stories. Whether you want to share your thoughts or simply have a casual chat, Dootchi gives you space to explore different topics and scenarios. A More Personal Experience Dootchi uses conversational context to help make interactions feel more relevant to your preferences and ongoing conversations.
Chat at Your Own Pace There is no need to rush. 

Start a conversation whenever you feel like talking, explore topics that interest you, and enjoy an experience that fits your mood.Designed with Care We are committed to continuously improving Dootchi’s usability, reliability, and overall experience. Your feedback helps us make the app better.

Thank you for being part of Dootchi. We appreciate your support and look forward to making your experience better with every update.
